headline: EU puts ChatGPT under the DSA's strictest tier; Gatekeeper jumps
body: A bright day for coordination. The European Commission designated ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine under the Digital Services Act, requiring systemic-risk assessments, mitigation and researcher data access within four months. Binding cross-border oversight raises Global Coordination and Alignment & Control, which lifts Gatekeeper (nations keeping a lid on runaway AI) and Protector God, and pulls Self-Destruction and Conquerors down. Eight smaller items, many from lower-credibility sources, barely moved things: data-centre protests, Meta's child-safety settlement and NHS AI-scribe errors added Tech Backlash; Andrew Bailey warned the G20 about AI cyber risk. Horizon Balance rose to -4.45, the best reading in two weeks.
movers_note: Gatekeeper +1.0, Self-Destruction -0.6 and Protector God +0.4, almost entirely from the EU's DSA designation of ChatGPT (+0.99, -0.70, +0.35).
coming_up: ChatGPT must deliver DSA systemic-risk assessments, mitigation and researcher data access within four months
